programs.title: Continuity and Antigravity foundation
programs.outcome: A clean checkout or a different harness can determine, execute, verify and resume the next bounded task without chat history.
programs.completionGate: All eleven Program A tasks pass focused tests, full-suite verification, a poisoned-result rejection test and a clean-checkout cross-harness drill.

programs.title: Perception foundation
programs.outcome: Raw reference evidence remains immutable while DOM, SVG, asset and runtime identities stay traceable across states.
programs.completionGate: Repeatable safe capture and evidence identity fixtures pass with absent evidence reported as unknown or blocked.

programs.title: First mechanism and bounded semantic judgment
programs.outcome: Handwritten SVG emphasis survives content and layout changes while Jev resolves only typed residual ambiguity in shadow mode.
programs.completionGate: Broken SVG variants fail, three target implementations preserve declared invariants and Jev cannot mutate or approve.

programs.title: Transmutation and motion infrastructure
programs.outcome: Controlled transmutation preserves invariants and exposes deterministic motion inspection through Node first and MCP second.
programs.completionGate: Unauthorized changes, lost reveals and conflicting animation owners fail; direct Node and MCP outputs are equivalent.

programs.title: Generalization and empirical quality proof
programs.outcome: A second mechanism generalizes the model and qualified references drive visibly superior directions measured by blind review.
programs.completionGate: Image-mask reveal works without SVG-specific shared logic and the predeclared blind benchmark passes with no P0 failure.

phases.title: Truth consolidation
phases.expectedResult: One authority chain, contradiction ledger, migration map and preservation policy.
phases.exitEvidence: Fresh inventory proves that no stale document can present itself as active authority.

phases.title: Continuity Core
phases.expectedResult: Strict schemas, canonical hashing, append-only evidence, roadmap state, drift detection and recovery.
phases.exitEvidence: A clean checkout selects the next valid task and rejects malformed, stale or contradictory state.

phases.title: Antigravity primary adapter
phases.expectedResult: Capability discovery, task projection, native roles and validated result ingestion.
phases.exitEvidence: A new Antigravity session executes one canonical task and refuses an invalid result.

phases.title: Portable adapters and manual fallback
phases.expectedResult: Gemini IDE V2, alternative harness and filesystem fallback share one normative contract.
phases.exitEvidence: The same task package runs in Antigravity, one alternative harness and manual fallback without requirement drift.

phases.title: Continuity and delegation test matrix
phases.expectedResult: Adversarial contracts, interruption recovery, role separation and no-chat-history drills.
phases.exitEvidence: After simulated executor loss, a different harness resumes and closes a safe task from repository evidence only.

phases.title: Research contract and safe capture
phases.expectedResult: Immutable capture manifests, environment readiness, hostile-page isolation and source boundaries.
phases.exitEvidence: Two captures preserve required evidence and missing dependencies never trigger destructive normalization.

phases.title: Minimal evidence and identity model
phases.expectedResult: Observed, derived, inferred and unknown records with stable spatial, temporal and causal identities.
phases.exitEvidence: A handwritten SVG, its text and animation retain traceable identity across declared states.

phases.title: Handwritten SVG vertical
phases.expectedResult: Topology, geometry, text association, timing and content-sensitive adaptation for one complete mechanism.
phases.exitEvidence: Changed text and layout preserve invariants, intentional negatives fail and blind review beats the generic baseline.

phases.title: Jev shadow integration and calibration
phases.expectedResult: Local Node adapter, typed questions, pinned model, evidence cache and append-only calibration.
phases.exitEvidence: Predictions are compared with independent outcomes and unresolved cases route to a human.

phases.title: Controlled transmutation kernel
phases.expectedResult: Mechanism model, invariants, permitted changes, lineage, actual diff guard and deterministic verifier.
phases.exitEvidence: The output explains what changed, why and from which evidence while unauthorized variables remain unchanged.

phases.title: Motion Capability Core and runtime adapters
phases.expectedResult: Engine-neutral CSS, WAAPI, GSAP and Motion inspection with ownership, seeking and trajectory capture.
phases.exitEvidence: Removed reveals and conflicting owners fail independently of final-frame visibility.

phases.title: MCP facade
phases.expectedResult: Narrow typed MCP tools over the proven local motion core with read and mutation boundaries.
phases.exitEvidence: MCP and direct Node results match and no tool receives arbitrary evaluation or approval authority.

phases.title: Image-mask reveal vertical
phases.expectedResult: A second mechanism validates shared identity and invariant abstractions.
phases.exitEvidence: The vertical passes without handwritten-SVG-specific branches in the shared model.

phases.title: Reference intelligence and direction boards
phases.expectedResult: Role-qualified reference packets, negative constraints, three distinct directions and intent goldens.
phases.exitEvidence: An agent reconstructs relationships without a raw clone and the owner chooses from visible differences.

phases.title: Review console and empirical benchmark
phases.expectedResult: Local evidence console, mechanical and editorial gates, telemetry, blind comparison and failure memory.
phases.exitEvidence: Immutable evidence supports promotion and the predeclared quality threshold passes with no P0 failure.

acceptance: Every implementation task names exact inputs, outputs, write scope and commands.
Capture and identity negative fixtures are specified before production code.
A separate verifier and the project owner approve the plan before any task becomes ready.
SVG invariants, free variables and intentional failure fixtures are explicit.
Jev remains shadow-only, hash-bound and unable to mutate or approve.
Blind comparison criteria and a human editorial gate are declared before implementation.
Transmutation permissions and actual diff enforcement are machine-testable.
Motion owner, reveal-loss and trajectory fixtures precede MCP exposure.
Direct Node and MCP parity plus security boundaries are explicit gates.
A second mechanism tests shared abstractions instead of copying SVG-specific logic.
Reference qualification and three materially distinct directions are measurable.
Blind benchmark, cost telemetry and signed human promotion are mandatory.

empiricalAssurance.proof: Strict machine-readable contracts reject unknown fields, stale hashes and invalid states.
A failing regression is captured before the smallest implementation and rerun after it.
The actual repository diff is compared with a normalized write allowlist.
Builder and verifier identities differ; executor self-reported success has no authority.
Preview, QA and promotion consume the same content-addressed artifact.
A clean checkout reconstructs the next valid action without conversation history.
The same canonical task and requirements run through at least two harnesses.
Mechanical validity cannot substitute for explicit human visual approval.
Predeclared comparisons measure improvement over the generic baseline without revealing the generator.
Tokens, latency, attempts and human interventions are recorded before any savings claim.
